programs.title: Sara's Australia Unveiled
programs.desc: Chef and TV presenter Sara La Fountain discovers Australia's hidden gems.He visits areas far from civilization, looking for regional products there.All this to create new flavor compositions with the help of local chefs.The dishes she will prepare from seasonal products will not be exquisite, but above all, tasty and nutritious.During her culinary expeditions, Sara will show viewers what a beautiful and diverse country Australia is.It will turn out that it is worth straying from the main trails to discover the extraordinary places of this geographically heterogeneous country, where we can see both deserts, rainforests and wetlands.

programs.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programs.desc: Eva zu Beck travels to the farthest corners of the Earth to find people with amazing abilities.In the Copper Canyon in Mexico, he meets ultramarathon champions from the Rarámuri tribe.In Tanzania, she tries to survive thanks to the knowledge she acquired from the Hadzabe, while in the deep Amazon, members of the Matis tribe teach her how to navigate in the vast jungle without a map or GPS.Later, he learns the secrets of carrying heavy loads to the highest peak in Africa and one of the highest in the world from the local porters.

programs.desc: Six wonderful train trips.There will be no shortage of awe-inspiring views.The authors of the series will also reveal the secrets of railway engineering.
